# HTML review fixtures

These small fixtures cover immutable artifact rendering, scripted navigation,
relative assets, repeated siblings, nested inline selections, Mermaid fallback,
and blocked active content. Symlink escapes and malformed paths are created in
temporary test directories rather than committed.

The first acceptance deck remains external at
`/home/akhil/warchives/unilever-dt-workshop/project/deliverables/20260912-unilever-global-dt-agentic-foundations-deck/deck.html`.
It must not be copied into this repository.
